static_traits.name: Natalie
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in, but not yet sharing romantic feelings with friends; socializing and expression affected by difficulties
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy; no similar psychological distress in romantic relationships before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation; slightly tense at the start but Positive attitude; able to describe automatic thoughts and trigger situations; willing to do recording and Homework

basic_info.main_problem: I am troubled by negative thoughts about a romantic relationship. I believe the person I fell in love with this summer does not reciprocate my feelings, and will never love me.
basic_info.core_demands: I am tired of this feeling, just want to find some peace, and no longer be so Anxious when with them; also improve mood and Learning performance.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Seeing a crush at school or trying to interact with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other does not immediately respond enthusiastically or show obvious interest, it means they do not care about me/hate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding expressing true feelings, Repression and distraction to try to control negative thoughts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She must hate me; she will never love me

special_situations.event: The crush not replying to messages in time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If messages are not yet replied to in time, it means the other does not care about me or is distancing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing proactive contact, Suppressing expression impulses, avoiding emotions through distraction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She does not care about me

special_situations.event: The other person seeming distracted when talking to one's crush or attention not focused
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other is not focused enough when chatting, it means they have no feelings for me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately Withdrawing, reducing closeness and interaction to avoid Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She has no feelings for me

special_situations.event: Increased stress after school started and not knowing how to express feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly express my feelings, I will definitely Be rejected and make the relationship awkward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Giving up confessing or advancing the relationship, Repressing emotions and choosing not to face it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, she will not love me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked, accepted, and to build intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being disliked, and the relationship becoming awkward
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected and maintaining surface security by staying distant and Suppressing expression

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough suitor/one who may Be rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Cold others who may reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether I express feelings or when faced with encouragement to do reality testing and behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client regards expressing needs as a high-risk event, subconsciously believing expression will bring rejection and embarrassment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone validating their Fear, starting with low-risk indirect expression exercises (e.g., writing unsent messages, Role playing), avoiding forcing an immediate confession; use short sentences, slow pace, emphasizing controllability and choice.

manifestations: Worrying the other does not love oneself, not yet sharing true feelings with friends, fearing expression will lead to Being rejected and Distant relationships
outcomes: Difficulty establishing connections with significant others

manifestations: Decreased interest in activities I originally enjoyed (summer walks, reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing liking for the crush, forcefully Repressing and distracting to 'handle it alone'
Choosing Withdrawal over seeking external support in interactions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Attributing own unease and feelings of being unworthy of love to the other 'hating me''not caring about me'
Determining others' negative attitudes based on few clues (not replying in time, Distraction)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and the 'I am not good enough' self-blaming narrative
Overly cautious, worrying that expression will cause embarrassment and thus limiting one's actions

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing or interacting with the crush at school, the client usually falls into catastrophic and mind-reading negative thoughts, followed by Low mood and avoiding expression.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In several situations of going out or spending time together during the summer vacation, the client did not completely Withdraw as usual, but interacted with the other and noticed the other was not avoiding her, which slightly eased her mood.
exception_events.reason: Clue: different situation (the more relaxed summer vacation environment), different support (the other responded positively: replying to messages and willing to spend time together), different approach (the client proactively participated in interaction rather than fully avoiding), so the intensity of negative thoughts decreased this time.

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and cooperate with recording tasks
There is positive interaction evidence (the other party replies to messages, is willing to spend time together)
Has friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and black-and-white thinking are marked
Avoiding expression due to fear of Being rejected
Rumination and Repression strategies maintaining negative emotions
New school year Increased stress triggering frequency

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly falls into negative automatic thoughts related to romantic situations and avoids expressing emotions
antecedent: Seeing or approaching their crush at school
The crush not yet replying to messages in time
The other person seeming distracted when talking to one's crush
School-start pressure and not knowing how to express feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: Strong Fear of Being rejected and cognitive biases like 'all-or-nothing/catastrophizing' maintaining negative rumination and avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible rejection and awkwardness, thus relieving Anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Persistently low mood and Anxiety, declining Learning performance, limited social life, Reduced interest in once-loved activities
